text: do u see any of these at all ? [Image #20] its weird u cant find it by name instantly and thats a real problem
resolution: Answered: yes, every Build model is visible to me — the door was findable only as its DISK folder Door_Wall_1; the user's rename to Door_with_knob_window lives solely in manifest.json's name field, because model folders are minted from the starter/doc id at creation and rename never touches them. The content browser resolves names from manifests so the user sees the right name, but any disk-level search (agents, file managers, grep by name) comes up empty — the findability gap the user flagged. Recommended fix (not yet built, awaiting the user's word on direction): sync the on-disk folder to a slug of the display name at save/rename time when nothing references the path, or keep folders id-stable by design (container-not-identity convention) and instead give the library a name-to-folder locator so disk consumers can resolve display names. The hollow-door diagnosis this message interleaved with is resolved under req_3043.
